study.notes: STUDY: interim analysis of the low dose part of a randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2 trial of mazdutide (a GLP-1 and glucagon receptor dual agonist) in Chinese overweight adults or adults with obesity without diabetes (NCT04904913), 248 randomised to mazdutide 3, 4.5 or 6 mg or placebo for 24 weeks, 224 completing, modified intention to treat. Table 3 prints the change or percentage change from baseline per arm as least squares mean with standard error and the estimated treatment difference versus placebo with a 95 percent CI for each dose; those differences are the rows (route ci_95). Nine inventory markers at three doses give 27 rows; the pool keeps the highest dose per biomarker. The four absolute difference rows carry the Table 1 baseline arm means as denominators. The fasting insulin rows carry none: its Table 1 baseline is a median with interquartile range, which amendment A12 refuses as a denominator for a skewed marker, so those three rows stay unconvertible. Serum uric acid and HDL cholesterol are outside the inventory. This is the second placebo controlled GLP-1 and glucagon receptor dual agonist trial in the corpus and the first to report the lipid and hepatic panel, so it changes class coverage for total and LDL cholesterol, triglycerides and ALT. Sponsored by Innovent Biologics (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low | AUTHOR SUPPLIED FROM REGISTRY 2026-10-19: the capture for this row did not print an author. json.design: randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2 trial, mazdutide 3, 4.5 or 6 mg versus placebo for 24 weeks in Chinese overweight adults or adults with obesity, 248 randomised
json.reason: full text group (Europe PMC); nine inventory markers carry an estimated treatment difference with a 95 percent CI at each of three doses
other_markers: body weight, BMI and waist circumference
proportions achieving 5 and 10 percent weight loss

rob.justification: randomised with a stratification factor and double blind against placebo (D1 and D2 low); 224 of 248 completed and missing week 24 data for the primary endpoint were imputed by last observation carried forward, with the secondary endpoints on a mixed model (D3 some concerns); central laboratory assays (D4 low); this is an interim analysis of the low dose part of a two part trial, and the cardiometabolic markers are secondary endpoints with no multiplicity adjustment, as the table states (D5 some concerns)

doubts: the three fasting insulin rows have no denominator and stay unconvertible, because the trial reports its baseline as a median
the report is an interim analysis of the low dose part; the 9 mg part is reported separately and is group 10 in this corpus (GLORY-2 is the phase 3 programme)
no multiplicity adjustment was made across the secondary endpoints, which the paper states explicitly
the authorship of the capture is not visible, so first_author is left for a verifier
